story.text: This story can fit 75-125 words.Selecting pictures or graphics is an important part of adding content to your newsletter.Think about your article and ask yourself if the picture supports or enhances the message you’re trying to convey. Avoid selecting images that appear to be out of context.Microsoft Publisher includes thousands of clip art images from which you can choose and import into your newsletter. There are also several tools you can use to draw shapes and symbols.Once you have chosen an image, place it close to the article. Be sure to place the caption of the image near the image.
